insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Flat 5% co-pay on every admissible claim; risk-based co-pay may replace this if mentioned in schedule

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; modern treatments at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) up to 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Not applicable for accidents; waived if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, calculi etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Code-Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in base policy

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour minimum not required for day-care

domiciliary.note: Covered if patient cannot be moved or no hospital bed available; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy etc.); cashless not available

ayush.note: Inpatient and day-care AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured

organ_donor.note: No explicit mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy etc.; sub-limited to 50% of SI

consumables.display: Not covered (base); covered under Home Care add-on
consumables.note: Consumables excluded from base policy (List I); a specific list of consumables covered under optional Home Care Treatment add-on

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (territorial limit clause)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except for fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium payment

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD treatment, treatment outside India, sterility/infertility, refractive error <7.5D, domiciliary for asthma/diabetes/hypertension/epilepsy

optional_riders.display: Flexi OP Care (OPD consultations, diagnostics, tele-consult); Home Care Treatment add-on (daily limit ₹1k–₹10k, listed conditions)
